title: Bounded NOR2 official 2022 source comparison and contact provenance

scope.native_state: Both remain held as territorial_exclusion_cells; this comparison changes no native state or credit.

distribution.acquisition: Direct public official Atom distribution; no account, payment, cart or terms acceptance used.

comparison_script.method: Only the two retained native center lon/lat coordinates were transformed with a local GRS80 UTM33 forward formula and tested against the complete 11-polygon Fylke family using even-odd point-in-ring, union of polygon patches and exclusion of interiors. This was not a full-target geometry or owner scan.

key_results.interpretation: The official 2022 full Fylke polygon corroborates the original simplified GeoBoundaries contact and adjacent historical WMS/current API lineage. This is adverse to a positive RUS repair; keep held.

A concrete 2022 official full-polygon comparison disagrees with the original simplified contact, and agrees with the adjacent-year WMS no-hit and 2026 point-API no-hit. This makes the source-specific contact discrepancy actionable for further original-contract review, but does not prove RUS membership or authorize assignment. Keep held pending any full predicate review.

original_contact_source_and_code.original_retained_source: gb:NOR:ADM1:71437522B84427958303197, simplified Kartverket-derived GeoBoundaries 2022 feature in an 11-feature family; original family decoded SHA-256 a24bd867e42c8f2d7bdd07e723594f2d55736d50de8cf1e92062ae443a0f0f72. This original contact source is simplified, unlike the full official 2022 GML just compared.

native_membership_implementation.relevance: The frozen stage's native intervals use nativePolygonIntervals at normative row latitudes; this is a native center-row interval representation, not a test of whole-cell footprint area or legal source authority.

reproduction_code_pin.role: Rebuilds and byte-compares the frozen original stage and patch, including its foreign-contact rows; it verifies the retained output rather than documenting the initial contact-scanner invocation.

original_contact_source_and_code.provenance_limit: The retained packets identify the source-contact result rows, source payload, native interval implementation and a verifier, but do not bind a separate original invocation/script for generating source-competitor-native-counts.json. No claim is made that this result was independently regenerated here.

terms_and_access.general_terms_summary: Kartverket's general terms state free products may be used commercially and non-commercially under CC BY 4.0 with attribution; the dataset-specific Data Norge record was not independently read (the exact record URL returned HTTP 404 HTML, 23,984 bytes, SHA-256 44e0dcd293d0f593bfd3bd89cc976d6bde3bda4749f0bdc7bdfcc7bed49f1fc3).

limits: The full 2022 official feature is a separate representation from the original 2022 simplified GeoBoundaries contact source; the comparison demonstrates a source representation discrepancy, not that the original's recorded contact is false.
The 27.553 m nearest-boundary distance is a computed geometric distance, not a stated accuracy or legal error tolerance.
The official GML comparison does not establish other original contract predicates, full-target physical/competitor status, sovereign status, or native ownership.

The local transform and point-in-polygon implementation were independently cross-checked with PyProj 3.7.2 and Shapely 2.1.2 on the same two existing points and complete 11-feature family; this remains a bounded check, not a new target/owner scan.
No full-source GeoBoundaries 2022 payload was retrieved as part of this bounded check.
An independent PyProj/Shapely cross-check confirmed both 2022 point-in-polygon outcomes; its 1 m CRS operation accuracy is not a source-geometry accuracy claim.

independent_numerical_crosscheck.method: Independent PyProj CRS84-to-EPSG:25833 operation and Shapely 2.1.2 covers/distance checks on the same two original coordinates and complete 11-feature 2022 Fylke family. All 11 geometries are valid.
independent_numerical_crosscheck.interpretation: Confirms the earlier bounded comparison outcomes using an independent CRS library and geometry implementation. The second key remains a source-specific representation discrepancy and a possible bounded positive-applicability review path; it is not proof of Russian ownership or an authorized assignment. The first remains adverse to a positive repair.
independent_numerical_crosscheck.limit: PROJ reports 1 m coordinate-operation accuracy; that is transform metadata, not source boundary accuracy. The sub-metre difference from the hand-written transform does not affect either point-in-polygon result. This check does not determine legal status, native owner, full physical status or the original contact generator.

report_revision.reason: Clarified the independent PyProj/Shapely cross-check and feed-level versus historical-entry timestamps; added a read-only exact original key/owner/native-hold and whole-target physical receipt binding. No geometry or owner operation was rerun.

No per-key physical issue intersection was computed here, so exact effect on this key remains unestablished. Preserve both target issues.
read_only_native_physical_binding.interpretation: Original target/owner and land class are bound; the official full 2022 Norwegian county comparison exposes a simplified-source discrepancy for this key, while the stock diagnostic still holds it for the NOR negative. Existing target physical evidence retains two adverse issue records. A positive path requires the complete original source/physical/native predicates and cannot infer Russian inclusion from Norway non-coverage.
